text: Marketing API drives marketing campaigns using custom data pulled directly from your app
quote: Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.

text: API root resource links to all other API resources and returns details about the user account
quote: The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API. Calling the root directory also returns details about the Mailchimp user account.

text: Transactional (Mandrill) sends targeted, event-driven messages via API or SMTP
quote: Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) sends targeted and event-driven messages via the API or SMTP, fast—with best-in-class deliverability.

text: Open Commerce is an open source, API-first, modular commerce stack for retailers
quote: Mailchimp Open Commerce (formerly Reaction Commerce) is an open source, API-first, modular commerce stack made for technical, growth-minded retailers.

text: Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience through the API
quote: Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience.

text: Send a campaign through the API; RSS campaigns send on their schedule and others send immediately
quote: Send a Mailchimp campaign. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaigns will send immediately.

quote: Send a new SMS message through Mandrill

text: Request an additional dedicated sending IP, provisioned within 24 hours
quote: Requests an additional dedicated IP for your account. Accounts may have one outstanding request at any time, and provisioning requests are processed within 24 hours.

text: Add inbound routes for an inbound email domain or an SMS program
quote: Add a new route to an inbound domain or SMS program. Provide either domain or phone (not both).

text: Manage a rejection allowlist; adding an address automatically removes it from the denylist
quote: Adds an email to your email rejection allowlist. If the address is currently on your denylist, that denylist entry will be removed automatically.

text: Transactional webhooks POST message events: send, deferral, bounces, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub, reject

text: Marketing webhooks notify a URL about subscriptions, changed email addresses, campaign sending, and more
quote: By entering a valid URL that’s set up to accept HTTP POST requests, you can receive updates on subscriptions, changed email addresses, campaign sending, and more.

text: Webhooks can sync Mailchimp activity and profile data with third-party apps or your own database
quote: Webhooks are one way for you to sync Mailchimp activity with third-party apps.

quote: Test and debug webhooks

text: Webhook payloads can be verified with signatures
quote: Verifying webhook signatures

text: Click tracking reports show which recipients clicked and how many times each link was clicked
quote: Click tracking shows you how many recipients clicked links in your email. If you have click tracking enabled, your email report will show which recipients clicked your links and how many times each link was clicked.

text: Tracking reports include open and click rates for each email
quote: Your Mailchimp tracking reports include open and click rates, which measure your recipients' engagement with your subject lines and email content.

text: Clicks are counted as opens even when the tracking image didn't load
quote: Recipients must open an email to click a link inside it. We'll consider those clicks as opens, even if the tracking image didn't load.

text: Bot activity can be filtered out of reports
quote: To learn more about how to exclude bot activity from your reports check out About Bot Activity and Bot Filtering.

text: Free Magento integration syncs customers and order data into your Mailchimp audience
quote: Mailchimp for Magento is a free integration that adds your customers and their order information to your Mailchimp audience.

text: Use Magento purchase data for product-recommendation emails and e-commerce tracking to measure campaign ROI
quote: Use Magento purchase data to send targeted emails with product recommendations, and turn on e-commerce tracking to measure campaign ROI.

text: Connected accounts let agencies switch between client accounts without sharing login credentials
quote: If you manage multiple Mailchimp accounts, you can access and switch between your clients’ accounts without sharing login information.

text: Analytics AI explains which campaigns and automations drive revenue, with plain-language reasons
quote: Analytics AI, part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence, explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue—and the plain-language reason why—so you can double down on what works.

text: AI recommendations are grounded in the store's real sales, campaigns, and customer behavior
quote: every recommendation is grounded in your store’s real sales, campaigns, and customer behavior.
